resources.string:
Programmer Calculator is committed to protecting your privacy. This application operates entirely offline on your device.

• Zero Data Collection: We do not collect, track, store, or transmit any personal data, identifiers, or analytics.
• Local Storage: Calculation history is saved strictly on your local device using a secure local database and is never shared.
• Permissions: Only VIBRATE permission is used to provide tactile haptic feedback for key presses.
• Third Parties: No third-party tracking, advertising, or profiling SDKs are included.
